title: Miami Halloween Weekend Latin Picks
igCaption:
Miami’s Halloween weekend starts at Bayfront Park and with one flying Cuban sandwich.
Oct. 31, Bayfront Park, free

Sources: Secret Miami, Miami New Times, Business Insider

#Miami #MiamiEvents #HalloweenMiami #ReggaetonMiami

scenes.text: Need a Miami Halloween plan with Latin flavor? Start with the free one at Bayfront Park on Halloween day.
Red Bull Flugtag returns to Bayfront Park on Halloween day. The event is free, and it comes back to Miami for the first time since 2013.
scenes.caption: Red Bull Flugtag returns to Bayfront Park on Halloween day. The event is free, and it comes back to Miami for the first time since 2013.

scenes.text: The Cuban Flyer is a human-powered flying Cuban sandwich with a Cuban flag tail. A Day in Miami teamed up with Sanguich on it.
scenes.caption: The Cuban Flyer is a human-powered flying Cuban sandwich with a Cuban flag tail. A Day in Miami teamed up with Sanguich on it.

scenes.text: The Flugtag world distance record stands at 78.5 meters, about 257.5 feet. That is the mark every team is chasing. If you’re at Flugtag, open NEAR and see who’s cheering beside you.
